description: This Python source file implements the integration with the Firecrawl search API, providing classes and methods to construct search requests, validate environment variables, transform request parameters, and parse Firecrawl's API responses into a unified internal format. It includes configurations tailored to Firecrawl's API specifics and adheres to the project's architecture for search transformations.
